interpretation_limit: The fractions and Wilson intervals summarize the tested collections under their respective electrophile and reaction-condition combinations.

RP-guided.endpoint: Nonzero numerical UV response aggregated by unique donor structure for the reported analysis.
RP-guided.electrophile: Five electrophile structures occur in the 108-pair experimental mapping.
RP-guided.conditions: Donor-specific experimental conditions assigned by reaction system.
RP-guided.candidate_space: The complete experimental ledger contains 102 unique donors across N-H, O-H, S-H and P-H records. Panel a reports the N/O/S 35/94 analysis fraction; panel b uses all 102 ledger donors.

LLM-only.endpoint: Final qualitative 有产物/不反应 call, displayed as Product/No product.
LLM-only.conditions: Bayesian-optimized conditions assigned to each reaction system.
LLM-only.candidate_space: Twenty direct-LLM recommendations; the set is not restricted to the N/O/S/P donor-center classes used to organize the RP-guided collection.

Literature-only.endpoint: Final qualitative 有产物/trace call, displayed as Product/Trace; trace is negative.
Literature-only.electrophile: Collection-specific electrophiles used in the recorded baseline experiments.
Literature-only.conditions: Bayesian-optimized conditions assigned to each reaction system.
Literature-only.candidate_space: Twenty unique literature-selected structures represented by 21 deposited source records, including one duplicated source structure and one supplemental record.

panel_a.content: Reported collection-positive fractions and Wilson intervals.
panel_a.rp_scope: Reported N/O/S donor analysis: 35 positives among 94 unique donors (NH 12/38, OH 11/36 and SH 12/20).
panel_a.baseline_scope: Complete deposited 20-structure direct-LLM and 20-unique-structure literature collections.
panel_a.comparability: Fractions summarize the tested collections under their respective electrophile and reaction-condition combinations.

panel_b.content: Exact donor-structure intersections among complete deposited collections.
panel_b.rp_scope: All 102 unique donors derived from actual_donor_smiles in candidates/experiment_mapping/mapping_108.json.
panel_b.baseline_scope: All 20 direct-LLM structures and 20 unique literature-selection structures.
panel_b.reproduction: Membership counts are derived by canonicalizing structures and counting Boolean membership patterns in RP-guided, LLM-only, Literature-only order.
